shape.fill={"color": "#E3C860"}
shape.line={"none": true}
insert.textBox={"rect": [48, 76, 860, 100], "text": "Offline-first is a product decision."}
format.font={"family": "Barlow Condensed"}
format.size={"size": 38}
format.color={"color": "#EDF2ED"}
format.paragraph={"spaceBefore": 0, "spaceAfter": 0, "lineSpacing": 1.1}
insert.textBox={"rect": [48, 210, 390, 65], "text": "During collection"}
format.font={"family": "IBM Plex Sans"}
format.size={"size": 30}
format.color={"color": "#E3C860"}
format.paragraph={"spaceBefore": 0, "spaceAfter": 0, "lineSpacing": 1.1}
insert.textBox={"rect": [48, 300, 390, 135], "text": "Show local save state. Avoid\nsuggesting that an unsynced note is\nbacked up remotely."}
format.font={"family": "IBM Plex Sans"}
format.size={"size": 22}
format.color={"color": "#EDF2ED"}
format.paragraph={"spaceBefore": 0, "spaceAfter": 0, "lineSpacing": 1.1}
insert.textBox={"rect": [510, 210, 390, 65], "text": "During reconciliation"}
format.font={"family": "IBM Plex Sans"}
format.size={"size": 30}
format.color={"color": "#E3C860"}
format.paragraph={"spaceBefore": 0, "spaceAfter": 0, "lineSpacing": 1.1}
insert.textBox={"rect": [510, 300, 390, 135], "text": "Expose conflicts. Let the researcher\nresolve meaning rather than silently\nreplacing text."}
format.font={"family": "IBM Plex Sans"}
format.size={"size": 22}
format.color={"color": "#EDF2ED"}
format.paragraph={"spaceBefore": 0, "spaceAfter": 0, "lineSpacing": 1.1}
slide.notes={"text": "The architecture must make state and uncertainty visible to the researcher.\n\nSource: Original concept scenario, not a real product, customer result, benchmark or release announcement.\n\nSource detail: The architecture must make state and uncertainty visible to the researcher."}
